_comment: Where each harness keeps the real tree of a practice source (the individual set, a shared set, a brought set).
Read by tools/precedent_source_home.py and nothing else: every tool asks it, never hard-codes /root or /home/user.
The tree lives in the home folder; any other path a tool resolves for the same source is a link pointing into it.
Morgan, 2026-10-19 (strength: decided): one path for every AI tool he uses, 'we can define a different path for each one'.
home: '$HOME' is the user's home directory; 'attach-workspace' is where the harness's repo-attach tool clones (the parent of the session's project).

web_env / web_home: when that environment variable is 'true', web_home is used instead. Claude Code on the web clones attached repos into /home/user, and nothing in a repository can move that, so the attach clone is the tree.

detect_env: a harness is recognised by one of these variables when PRECEDENT_HARNESS does not name it. Only variables seen set by that harness are listed; each adapter under templates/harness/ sets PRECEDENT_HARNESS itself.
